feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Chris Van Hollen says he can beat Chuck Schumer. Here's his case
entry.summary: Sen. Chris Van Hollen told NPR's Morning Edition why he believes he can defeat Sen. Chuck Schumer and what he would change about Senate Democratic leadership.

entry.title: Trump administration requests $50B in funding after nationwide flight disruptions
entry.summary: As air travel begins to return to normal following a Friday ground stop and weekend chaos, the battle now turns to Congress and a funding fight for the FAA.

entry.title: Air traffic controllers' union head on the nationwide ground stop
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks the head of the air traffic controllers' union what it was like for controllers as the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop.

entry.title: Regulating AI will being a top priority for congressional Democrats in the new year
entry.summary: A big priority for the incoming Congress will be regulating artificial intelligence. Democrats will face stiff opposition from the Trump administration and its hands-off policy towards AI.

entry.title: Why sleep matters when it comes to weight gain and loss
entry.summary: Sleep can have a powerful impact on weight. Research shows it can affect appetite. There is also a two-way relationship between sleep quality and diet.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Thousands of travelers are still waiting to reschedule flights after Friday's nationwide ground stop, Sen. Chris Van Hollen mounts bid to become Senate majority leader, President Trump heads to Asia.

entry.title: Hip-hop streetwear pioneer Karl Kani shares how he built his brand in new memoir
entry.summary: NPR's A Martinez speaks with hip-hop streetwear pioneer Karl Kani about his memoir, "Karl Kani: A Life By Design."

entry.title: Doctor explains why he shared footage of the destruction a hospital in the Gaza Strip
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with Dr. Goher Rahbour, who survived an Israeli air strike on Nasser Hospital in the Gaza Strip and operated on another surgeon killed in the attack.

entry.title: Trump to arrive in the Philippines as Southeast Asian leaders meet for ASEAN summit
entry.summary: President Trump will arrive in Manila Monday as Southeast Asian leaders gather for the ASEAN summit.

entry.title: Affordability was a key issue for midterm voters. It helped make childcare one, too
entry.summary: Childcare costs have surged, putting a major financial burden on U.S. families. Advocates say the subject once on the fringes of political debate became a major issue during the midterms.
